name: Leucovorin
halfLifeSource: FDA label for Leucovorin Calcium (leucovorin calcium), Clinical Pharmacology - terminal t½ = 6.2 h
halfLifeNotes: 25 mg IV/IM dose in male volunteers, measured as total reduced folates (parent 5-formyl-THF converts rapidly to circulating 5-methyl-THF, so the label states no parent-only value); oral gives 5.7 h.
